subject: National literals
notes: "National literals are of the class and category national" (cite.py --check 8.3.3.5.4 -> OK, rule 2). ClassOf maps both prefixes N and NX to LiteralClass.National, NationalLiteralOperand binds Category = PicCategory.National, ConcatOperand keeps National. Probe e1 (--std 2002/2014): MOVE N"AB" TO PIC X and MOVE NX"0041" TO PIC X both refused COBOL0819 (national sender to alphanumeric receiver, Table 16) - the category is observed for both formats. No test found that asserts class/category for BOTH formats from this rule (NationalLiteral_InNumericContext_Rejects0844 pins only the not-numeric half of F1), so test-ref left empty. [editions as adjudicated: COBOL-2002, COBOL-2014, COBOL-2023 (national literals are a COBOL-2002 introduction; absent from COBOL-85, where the construct is rejected COBOL0900 via Constructs.NationalData2002)]
